topography.project_purpose: CDP. Structurally: 82 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 18 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC1155 multi-token; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 14 common project-authored base contract(s) (rtoken, rtokeninterface, rtokenstorage). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
